Objective: Given 1:1 support, visual supports, and interest-based check-ins with a trusted adult, and with acceptance of his autistic social engagement style, Ezra will identify and describe his lived experience during identified school activities by completing a co-created “Lived Experience Reflection Tool” that includes (a) naming the activity, (b) rating his regulation level using a 5-point visual scale, (c) selecting emotional and/or sensory descriptors from a visual menu, and (d) identifying one support or environmental adjustment need, independently completing all four components in 4 out of 5 observed opportunities, as measured and recorded through work samples and direct observation data by the special education teacher and/or school social worker.
